§6M1TTY Environment Suit§f

§aMid-game power armor that handles radiation, chemicals, and underwater exploration. A serious upgrade.§f

The M1TTY Environment Suit is a powered armor set. Each piece holds §e100kHE§f charge and charges at §e1kHE/t§f. Full set gives §bSpeed§f and §bJump Boost§f bonuses plus §e89.99%§f radiation reduction.

Crafting per piece uses Titanium Plate, Rubber Bar, and a Microchip (helmet only). You'll need Titanium production set up first.

Protection covers airborne particles, particulates, chemical gas, bacteria, corrosive fumes, carbon monoxide, bright lights, eye irritants, and radiation (1.0 resistance).

Bonuses: high mobility on ground and underwater, underwater night vision, vectored jetpack-like propulsion, 75% fire resistance, 75% fall damage reduction.

§ePS:§f Upgrade from basic hazmat gear once you have Titanium. The M1TTY suit makes hazardous area exploration dramatically safer.
